title: Incident finding event (post-incident-review emit)
summary: Structured incident finding emitted by the post-incident-review playbook when the corrective-action-tracking step closes. Bound to OCSF Incident Finding so downstream dashboards, control-effectiveness rollups, and regulator-facing final-report compilers consume a single shape regardless of which orchestrator emitted it. This is the same OCSF class used by the data-exfil playbook's regulator-notification emit; downstream consumers distinguish records by the bound playbook step.
sources: OCSF v1.3.0 — Findings category (2), Incident Finding class (2005)
